Recorded claim:
D319397 replaces time-based `mReturnedLogins` with `mSuppliedPasswords` keyed by `prePath:realm:username`. `PREVIOUS_FAILED` belongs to a prior prompt for one channel, so credentials must be tracked per channel (for example, a `WeakMap`): otherwise channel B can overwrite saved password A and channel A's failure can delete B. Add a two-channel regression test. Exact patch application, `git diff --check`, `node --check`, and focused ESLint passed; xpcshell was not run. [Task 6]
